entities.name: Tefemburu
entities.description: Harbour-city in Zhalfir on Dominaria that stood against Kaervek during the Mirage War.

entities.name: Kaervek
entities.description: Enemy besieging Tefemburu during the Mirage War.

entities.name: Hakim Loreweaver
entities.description: Wove a spell phasing Kaervek's forces out of existence at Tefemburu.

entities.name: Mirage War
entities.description: War in which Tefemburu was the second city to stand against Kaervek.

entities.name: Ufunguo
entities.description: City that fell to Kaervek before Tefemburu.

events.summary: Tefemburu was the second city forced to stand against Kaervek after the fall of Ufunguo.

events.summary: Heroes of Jamuraa set a trap; Hakim Loreweaver phased the attacking forces out of existence so civilians could flee.
events.quote: Hakim Loreweaver wove a spell around the attacking forces, phasing them out of existence and allowing the civilians to flee to safety.

events.summary: At dawn the allies destroyed both the abandoned city and the enemy armies with a spell.
events.quote: At dawn, the allies used a spell to destroy both the abandoned city and the enemy armies.
